## GATE PROTOCOL (how the orchestrator pauses for the operator — the only human touchpoints in the run)

Before dispatching a ticket whose `Gate` cell is non-empty (and **after** P19.5 for HG-14), the orchestrator:
1. Reads the ticket's `- **Gate status:**` block (and, for HG-14, `docs/build/CAPSTONE_CLOSURE.md` §(b)).
2. **Stops and asks the operator** (interactive question; if the harness cannot ask, print the block and end the turn) for each item: tick / value / **skip for now**. Never guess an answer; never tick on the operator's behalf.
3. Records the answers verbatim in **GATE DECISIONS** below (ticket, gate id, item, answer, date). Secrets are **never** written here — for HG-09/HG-07/HG-08 the operator exports env vars in the shell the worker runs in; the ledger records only `provided: yes/no`.
4. Dispatches the worker with the prompt addition: *"Gate answers for this ticket are in the build ledger GATE DECISIONS table — copy them into the ticket's Gate status block in your first commit and act on them."*
5. If every item was "skip": the ticket runs ungated; on completion the orchestrator adds it to `returnPass:` and the RETURN PASS table with the re-run command.

Gate → pause map: **before P20.2** HG-13 (A1–A8) · **after P19.5** HG-14 (ACCEPTED list; recorded by P20.1) · **before P21.1** HG-03 (which sources to flip; answer may be "decide after reading the packets" = skip, then return pass) + HG-04 · **before P21.3** HG-03 (flipped sources now?) + HG-09 (env tokens exported?) · **before P21.4** HG-12 staging target + HG-01 + HG-11 + HG-02 + Go-public · **before P21.5** HG-07 + HG-12 + A1 state · **before P21.7** HG-08 + HG-10 · **before P21.8 / P21.9** HG-03/HG-04 for the new sources. P19.3 has a **precondition** (Docker) rather than a gate: check `docker info` before dispatch; if absent, ask the operator to start Docker (real block if refused).

## CROSS-CUTTING INVARIANTS (every ticket re-checks; from `docs/tickets/_TEMPLATE.md`)
- Defining standard (§3.1): no unexplained dots/edges; no silent overwrites; no synthetic certainty; every node has identity; every state has time; every claim has evidence; every inference is labelled; every contradiction stays visible.
- Part VIII is binding (§0.7): no plate/trip/per-person storage or lookup; officer-naming gate; sensitivity tiers + coordinate rules; licence gate + ODbL separation.
- Append-only & provenance (P1–P3): no writable "current value" columns; corrections are new assertions.
- Additive/back-compat: never break a prior ticket's wire names, IDs, or schema contracts; new fields optional.
- Post-build specific: never fabricate green (blocked = recorded); secrets only via env; `docs/build/*` is the durable memory; `spec_src` → `BUILD.sh` is the only way to change the spec.

## OUT OF SCOPE (no ticket does these)
- Flipping `ingestion_permitted`, recording outreach outcomes, naming a legal home, counsel opinions, creating accounts, paying for infra — human gates only.
- **Merging any PR, tagging, pushing to `main`, changing branch protection, deleting branches** — operator actions after the chain (`docs/build/INTEGRATION_PLAN.md` §(d)); neither a ticket nor the orchestrator does them.
- Automated OSM edits; real fetch of any un-reviewed source; FR/BE live ingestion (design-gated false); a second jurisdiction (P22+).
- Rewriting the risk register or ADR bodies (cross-ref suffixes and new ADRs only); editing `docs/2_canonical_design_spec.md` directly.
- Committing raw agent ledgers, PR bodies, logs, or this file.

## SETUP checklist
0. **Overrides of the skill's defaults (deliberate, operator rule):** do **not** create a sibling worktree or a `<user>/sig-postbuild` base branch. `buildWorktree` = the main checkout `/Users/stevenvitali/Eleutheria`; `pinnedBaseSha` = `1baf05f` (NOT origin/main — every open PR forks from P07.3's tip and the chain continues from P18.2's); `chainTip` = `devin/p18-2-france-belgium`. Reason: P19.1 must see the **untracked, gitignored** `.agents/scratch/` and `scratch/` trees, which exist only in the main checkout. From P19.2 on a sibling worktree would work, but keep one worktree for the whole chain to avoid two `.agents/scratch` roots.
1. Confirm checkout `devin/p18-2-france-belgium` @ `1baf05f`, clean tree (`.devinignore` untracked is expected); `git fetch origin`.
2. Baseline: `make check` green (2363 tests, verify-gen clean); `docker info` works (needed from P19.3).
3. No benchmark fixture (benchmarkSet N/A).
4. Set `chainTip=devin/p18-2-france-belgium`, `nextTicket=P19.1`, `projectStatus=IN_PROGRESS`.
5. **Dispatch details:** (a) `chainTip` advances to each ticket's branch; there is **no** base switch — the whole chain stays on top of `devin/p18-2-france-belgium`. (b) Each ticket's `Run:` line carries its own `live_verification` value — pass it through verbatim in the worker prompt. (c) Workers run **one at a time, in the foreground** (a background subagent cannot be granted tool approvals). (d) RETURN PASS: before CAPSTONE, the orchestrator lists `returnPass:` tickets whose gates now have answers and offers to re-run them (set `nextTicket:` to that id; on completion resume at CAPSTONE).
6. After P19.1 completes, set `canonicalSpec: docs/build/DECISION_MEMO.md` (the memo moved there) — the build ledger itself stays at this path.
7. **SETUP is the only step that touches the tree before a ticket:** nothing is created — SETUP only verifies (checkout, clean tree, `make check`, `docker info`) and writes this ledger.

## CAPSTONE checklist (after P22.2)
0. Offer the RETURN PASS (SETUP note 5d); then pause for the operator's go-ahead to start the capstone (it opens one more stacked PR from `sig-postbuild-capstone`; it merges nothing).
1. Fresh whole-chain gap analysis of rows 47–65 against `DECISION_MEMO.md` §3/§5/§6 + the spec ids in `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` — MET / MET-DIFFERENTLY / PARTIAL / MISSING / AT-RISK-INTEGRATION; hunt seams between P19.4's store/sink, P19.5's gates, P21.2's repos, P21.3's runner, P21.4's runtime.

Landed the design-aware evaluator + preregistered confidence gate in **shadow/inactive mode** — computed and reported, `applied=()` always; the explicitly PROVISIONAL production policy (`camera_sites.decide_auto_write_tiers` + the P28-era point metrics) is untouched and its numbers ride the report labelled `historical_point_gate`, never eligibility evidence. **`resolution/evaluator.py` (new, ~1.1k LOC, stdlib-only):** (a) four separate estimands each with its own frame — `auto_positive_precision` (strict verified-same share per tier/scope/stratum), `candidate_recall` (`unavailable` on a candidate-only frame — it cannot observe blocking false negatives; undecided reference units enter the strict lower denominator), `cluster_quality` (pairwise + B-cubed over reference-cluster memberships; `unavailable` on a pair-only frame; unlabeled entities stay in coverage, never invented singletons) and `labelability` (decisive share, abstentions counted) — each carrying numerator, denominator, weights, method and `measured | partial | unavailable`. (b) Inference matched to the declared `SamplingDesign`: exact one-sided `clopper_pearson_lower` only under `independent_bernoulli` — which additionally requires `equal_probability`, item-level independence, a recorded `independence_basis` and no shared dependency group among certifying units (correlated/enriched samples can never select it); finite `finite_srs`/`stratified_srs`/`grouped_psu` frames use exact `hypergeometric_lower_bound` (randomness in the sampling design, not the correlated content); multi-cell hypotheses combine `Σ_c W_c L_c` with Bonferroni alpha across sampled cells and exact-0 for unmeasured cells; enriched strata are diagnostic-only.
